name: Si Kitul
bio: Kitul has a creditor and a story to pass on. Someone who heard the same conversation may tell it differently; the debt does not establish which account is true.
notes: fact: Brown names Kittul in the debt and accusation chain and records his execution on Mahmud’s order (Brown ch. XXII, pp. 161–164)
gameplay: Debt as leverage over who carries a rumor is a story mechanic, not evidence that Kitul served as a debt bondsman or held a port office (people-factions.md §2; port-labour.md §3)
